none: PAS CAM-811B03: Copper-alloy contemporary copy of a Nummus Roman Coin of Magnentius
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [VICTORIAE D D N] N AVG ET [CAE/S].-//

Copper alloy contemporary copy of a Nummus of Magnentius. Mint unknown, 351-361. Reece period 18. Obverse shows bare-headed bust, draped and cuirassed right. Reverse shows 2 Victories holding a wreath, (inscribed VOT/V/MVLT/X). Reverse legend reads [VICTORIAE D D N] N AVG ET [CAE/S].-//. Condition Fine, die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight 2.21g, diameter 17.43mm. Ref. Boon. pl.VIII, c.f.150
